description: v1 release gate. Each question lists files a correct answer should cite (any one counts as a hit). Questions with expect_absent=true ask about something the repository does not do; a good answer says so instead of inventing it. Expected files for itsdangerous and starlette reflect their layout as of 2025-2026; adjust if upstream moves files.

repositories.note: Not memorized by models: tests retrieval, not recall.
